mission: Per-PR mission files (ROADMAP item 22, owner GO 2026-10-19 09:24Z): each DATA-lane PR adds one docs/agent/missions/<name>.json, carried state moves to docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json, the diff hash covers the PR's own change (merge-base to head, full index). policy-gate still runs the base policy with unchanged evaluate() rules; delivery and verification compose fleet state plus the merge's own mission and fail closed. This is the last PR evaluated against STAGING_MISSION.json (bootstrap).

impacts.reason: policy-gate: the base policy finds the PR's mission itself; the legacy manifest path runs only while the base has no scripts/staging_mission.py. staging-automerge: the scope step composes the merge's own mission into a temp file that the RAW migration, collector rollout and verification steps read; a full delivery without exactly one added mission refuses. Registers test_staging_mission.py.
Same delivery-step changes as the staging-automerge job (reusable copy).
Hand-merge verification composes fleet state plus the merge's mission (if any) instead of reading STAGING_MISSION.json; fails on a changed, removed or duplicated mission.
New: find the PR's one added mission, merge-base full-index diff hash, compose fleet plus mission into the old manifest shape, digest/compose CLI. Read-only, local Git only.
DATA lane reads the mission and fleet state from the PR head via staging_mission; evaluate() is unchanged. --manifest is accepted and ignored.
Skip decision keys on one added mission file instead of the shared manifest; changed, removed, duplicated or unreadable missions run full (which then refuses).
Mission files and the fleet state classify as DATA, like the manifest.
Component expectations come from STAGING_MISSION_MANIFEST (the delivery's composed manifest), else the fleet state.
New fleet state: deployment_verification and operational_notes copied from STAGING_MISSION.json at the base, no deployment requests.
Zero, two, changed and removed missions; hash survives merging staging in; full index; fleet and mission override rules; compose CLI; workflow wiring; updated fixtures.
Describe per-PR missions, the fleet state, the post-collector pin, bootstrap and rollback; item 22 status.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge plus one docs/agent/missions/<name>.json (the new base gate admits it). After it merges the single STAGING_MISSION.json flow is back; the next DATA PR regenerates STAGING_MISSION.json against staging as before.
recovery.trigger: policy-gate refuses a correct mission, Verify staging merge or staging-automerge fails in the compose step, or the first collector delivery on the new layout does not run Deploy mission-scoped staging collectors.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: Verify staging merge on this hand merge, then the next DATA PR's policy-gate on a mission file, then the first collector PR's staging-automerge (allowed collector window) with Deploy mission-scoped staging collectors and the delivery verification passing.
